original_checklist.search_scope: Current tracked/untracked project Markdown/text/CSV/JSON names and content; all available Git path history. No complete 114-row master or full 27-row original Phase 4 list was located.
original_checklist.not_a_replacement: REC-* IDs are audit-assigned mappings of recoverable original labels. SUP-* records are supplemental scope observations, not original checklist entries; no phantom 24 requirements were created.

completion.full_original_exact_percentage_reason: The complete original inventory/criteria are unavailable, so an exact full-project completion percentage and 114-item five-status census cannot be independently established.

confirmed_original_lower_bound.interpretation: Strict confirmed minimum against the reported original denominator; NOT certification that all 114 requirements were verified.

recoverable_original_subset.interpretation: Exact verified fraction of the 90 recoverable named original requirements only.

inventory_only_upper_bound.interpretation: If every one of the 24 unmapped original requirements were complete, under the present judgments on the known 90. Not an estimate or accepted completion result.

prior_report.reason: Prior report lacks a complete inventory and used different evidence judgments; do not subtract unlike completion claims.

implementation_vs_verification.meaning: COMPLETE requires code plus recorded bounded verification, not merely a file. A historical scratch/dev pass does not establish current production runtime; runtime_verification_needed separately records live/deployment/independent evidence still required. UNVERIFIED is never counted COMPLETE.

work_since_previous_audits.detail: Recorded scratch/PDF and API verification now exists; invalid/corrupt/password/size/page/replace rollback coverage was added.
Silent last-user fallback and lossy IDs are removed; source union, role/ownership validation and orphan handling are implemented.
Previously hidden checks executed: 106 process-memory and 137 routing checks; later merged full run 49/49, 18 live/manual excluded.
Rewrite-before-classify implemented, 20 checks and six-case live dev evidence; C-direct-05 remains variable.
Cited-passage numeric guards, repair and retrieval-status output implemented; nonnumeric semantic grounding remains incomplete.
Versioned base schema, pinned API dependencies, lazy startup/client/models and authenticated API source plus bounded HTTP tests are present; full security/deployment verification is not established.

work_since_previous_audits.area: Evaluation runner safety and frozen manifest
work_since_previous_audits.detail: Gate runs before side effects; frozen manifest and refusal tests exist. Official run-once/authenticity/runtime binding hardening remains pending.
Pure modules, two input-boundary fixes, opt-in isolated publication, 89-row/135-chunk development replay and regression records were added.
Four staged review records, SC-06/07/08 alternatives, exact gate policy, runtime capture proposal, candidate re-freeze and 35-item pending dashboard are prepared; none accepted.

Filtered ANN and RSS results already exist. Their discovery corrects the old audit; it does not establish they were newly run after that audit. ANN filter coverage is trivial, not production validation.

critical_blockers.description: 24 of the claimed original 114 requirements have no recoverable descriptions/criteria.
critical_blockers.next_action: Obtain the actual original checklist from the owner; do not reverse-engineer 24 labels from current code.

critical_blockers.description: Independent reviewer judgments, real annotation review and final answer-quality acceptance are missing.
critical_blockers.next_action: Assign reviewers; record blind-first judgments, prioritizing D-conflicting-01; preserve pending fields until real decisions arrive.

critical_blockers.description: SC-06/07/08, V5/V9, metrics/threshold identities, correction set, authentic approvals and approved official integration/refreeze remain undecided.
critical_blockers.next_action: Resolve written policy alternatives, then implement only authorized versioned changes. Keep v1 official.

critical_blockers.description: Historical public-dump exposure containment and least-privilege deployment have no current independently established completion.
critical_blockers.next_action: Owner obtains external containment evidence and separately approves scratch least-privilege checks. Do not query rag_db in this audit.

critical_blockers.description: Current schema state, restore drill, negative auth/network controls, concurrency/load and current performance instrumentation are not established.
critical_blockers.next_action: Define a bounded scratch/local test plan, source-bound results and recovery criteria; no production rollout based on source presence.

critical_blockers.description: H.1, classification variability, multipage retrieval misses, same-dimension model mismatch and semantic grounding remain open.
critical_blockers.next_action: Resolve behavior policies and run approved development-only experiments; never silently change frozen thresholds.

critical_blockers.description: Original upload bytes, Tier 2 runtime overrides/order and exact prompt bytes are unavailable or unproven.
critical_blockers.next_action: Recover originals if possible; otherwise retain the explicit limitation and install reviewed capture only for future authorized runs.

recommended_execution_order: Recover the missing master-list source and confirm product/deployment scope; preserve the frozen baseline and all current work.
Assign independent reviewers and record blind-first judgments; disposition the four flips and annotation evidence without assistant-generated approvals.
Resolve canonical SC-06/07/08, V5/V9, gate/threshold, correction-set and approval/run-once decisions. Do not reopen completed scorer engineering without a defect or approved policy change.
Under separate explicit authorization, validate current scratch schema, final lifecycle, negative API/auth/Host/CORS, cache/telemetry and restore behavior with no provider calls by default.
Review and implement remaining production hardening: DB pooling/deadlines, total-turn cancellation, concurrency, semantic/retrieval quality and embedding model identity; measure before deployment.
Review actual official runner/runtime capture and gate changes, preserve deterministic v1 rollback, regenerate actual hashes and obtain a separately authorized freeze.
Only after all prerequisites and separate explicit authorization, perform the once-only held-out evaluation and produce an independently accepted, reproducible final report.
Certify the selected local/production deployment with security, recovery and load evidence; add clean-environment CI and a canonical current documentation entry point.
